title: 前後念都一樣（回文）
question:
「level」從前面念、從後面念都一樣，這種字叫回文。
請輸入一個英文單字，先輸出它倒過來的樣子（從最後一個字往前接成新的字串），再判斷是不是回文：是就輸出「是回文」，不是就輸出「不是回文」。

test_case.note: 偶數個字也可以是回文

en.title: Same Both Ways (Palindrome)
en.question:
"level" reads the same from the front and from the back. A word like this is a palindrome.
Input an English word. First output it backward (join the letters from the last one to the first one into a new string). Then output "Yes" if it is a palindrome, or "No" if it is not.

test_case.note: An even number of letters can work too
